description: This file implements a React component for a quiz review page, including quiz initialization, navigation, answer selection, and spaced repetition grading UI.

methods.name: startQuiz
methods.description: Initializes and starts a quiz by fetching questions from the API and shuffling choices if necessary.

methods.name: selectChoice
methods.description: Records the user's selected answer for a particular question.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next question in the quiz.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Returns to the previous question in the quiz.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits the user's answers to the backend API and displays the quiz score.

methods.name: grade
methods.description: Grades the current card with a spaced repetition prompt, allowing selection of 'easy', 'good', or 'hard'.
